title: Reclining Nymph with Small Dog
retrieved_via: Official museum UI, Collections Search, exact object detail, 2026-09-19
attribution: After Georg Raphael Donner; possibly attributable to Jakob Gabriel Mollinarolo
credit: Harvard Art Museums/Busch-Reisinger Museum, Association Fund
gallery_text_paraphrase: A small lead cast after Donner’s Austrian-rivers fountain figure in Vienna; the model may be by one of his followers. The reclining adult figure pets a dog alongside her.
conflict_resolution: Museum record takes precedence over the Polycam uploader’s bronze material label.
